images.filename: Flickr - law keven - The last days of...Hmmmm...Summer...jpg
images.caption:
Highest Explore Position #255 ~ On September 23rd 2008.
Sunset - Greenwich Park, London, England - Sunday September 21st 2008.
Click here to see the Larger image
Click here to see My most interesting images
Well, I missed the actual sunset yesterday....as I was stuck in traffic on the M2!!!!!
However I did manage to catch the tail end of it.....so here it is...the last day of our rubbish Summer....we had glorious weather this weekend, and the sunset was awesome, if only I wasn't stuck on the motorway at the time...:O((
I'm good lol....but not that good..:O))

Anyhoo, I'm in Colchester all day today, so I will hopefully spend some time catching up with you all tomorrow...I hope your all having an awesome week.....:O)))

images.filename: Flickr - law keven - Time....to reflect....jpg
images.caption:
Greenwich Reflection - Greenwich Park, London, England - Sunday September 14th 2008.
Click here to see the Larger image
Click here to see My most interesting images
Well, I thought I had lost this and all the other images I took yesterday morning, when my computer crashed and I had to re-boot to factory settings!!!!
Luckily all the files survived, however my AOL broad band connection did not, and refuses to work!!
So sorry for my lack of visits to your wonderful streams, but I now only have dial up...which is much slower then I remember it to be, making it almost impossible to open many of the wonderful images you all have..:O(((
I am currently at work, which is the only place I can use a broad band connection, I can only have limited time on it though...I do have to do some work as well....lol..:O)))
So hopefully I will sort out the connection soon....Oh...and this image was taken in Greenwich park at dawn yesterday morning....Hence the title...(Greenwich being the home of time)....I don't just throw these titles together you know...lol

Anyhoo, I hope you all have an awesome Monday...:O)))

images.filename: Flickr - law keven - Early to bed, Early to Rise.....jpg
images.caption:
Highest Explore Position #146 ~ On September 15th 2008.
Sunrise - Greenwich Park, London, England - Sunday September 14th 2008.
Click here to see the Larger image
Click here to see My most interesting images
Quick Update: I'm having computer problems at the moment, my broad band isn't working, so I am using dial up...which is slower then I ever imaged it to be, so bear with me if I haven't visited your wonderful sites...I'll do so once I have sorted out the broad band..:O)))
Yup....for the first time EVER...I got up at the crack of Dawn and captured my first English Sunrise...I've done a few in France before but for some reason, never here...maybe that's because the sun hardly ever appears here lol...:O)))
So....yes, it's a lovely sunny day here right now, so I may head out again this afternoon..:O))
And a note to my Flickr Chum Linda....I took hundreds of Sunrise shots this morning, so you can expect to see quite a few of these in the coming months lol...:O))))

I hope everybody is having an awesome Sunday...:O)))
